<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Latheesh Nair — Professional Portfolio</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@500;600;700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#0B0D12;
    --bg-panel:#12151C;
    --bg-card:#151922;
    --border:#262B36;
    --border-soft:#1C2029;
    --text:#E7E9EE;
    --text-dim:#8A93A3;
    --text-dim2:#5C6472;
    --amber:#EDA33B;
    --teal:#4FD1C5;
    --coral:#F0637A;
    --violet:#9B8CFF;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{
    margin:0;
    background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--text);
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  h1,h2,h3,.display{
    font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;
    font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:-0.01em;
  }
  .mono{ font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; }
  .eyebrow{
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
    font-size:0.72rem;
    letter-spacing:0.14em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--text-dim);
  }
  a{color:inherit;}

  /* ---------- Nav ---------- */
  nav{
    position:sticky; top:0; left:0; right:0;
    z-index:40;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
    padding:16px 40px;
    background:rgba(11,13,18,0.88);
    backdrop-filter:blur(8px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft);
    gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap;
  }
  .nav-name{
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
    font-size:0.8rem;
    letter-spacing:0.06em;
    color:var(--text-dim);
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .nav-name span{color:var(--amber);}
  .nav-right{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:28px;}
  .nav-links{display:flex; gap:26px; font-size:0.8rem;}
  .nav-links a{
    text-decoration:none; color:var(--text-dim); position:relative;
    padding-bottom:4px; transition:color .25s;
  }
  .nav-links a::after{
    content:""; position:absolute; left:0; bottom:0;
    width:0%; height:2px; background:var(--amber); transition:width .25s;
  }
  .nav-links a:hover{color:var(--text);}
  .nav-links a:hover::after{width:100%;}
  .btn-resume{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
    font-size:0.74rem; font-weight:600;
    padding:9px 16px;
    border-radius:6px;
    background:var(--amber);
    color:#1A1200;
    text-decoration:none;
    white-space:nowrap;
    transition:filter .2s;
  }
  .btn-resume:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);}

  /* ---------- Hero ---------- */
  header.hero{
    padding:90px 40px 60px;
    max-width:1080px; margin:0 auto;
  }
  .hero-title{
    font-size:clamp(2.4rem, 6vw, 4.2rem);
    line-height:1.02;
    margin:14px 0 8px;
  }
  .hero-title .accent{color:var(--amber);}
  .hero-role{
    font-size:clamp(1rem,2vw,1.2rem);
    color:var(--text-dim);
    font-weight:400;
    margin:0 0 30px;
    max-width:680px;
    line-height:1.65;
  }
  .hero-role b{color:var(--text); font-weight:700;}
  .btn-row{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px; margin-bottom:44px;}
  .btn{
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
    font-size:0.85rem; font-weight:600;
    padding:12px 20px;
    border-radius:7px;
    text-decoration:none;
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
    transition:transform .18s, filter .18s, border-color .18s;
  }
  .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);}
  .btn-solid{background:var(--amber); color:#1A1200;}
  .btn-solid:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);}
  .btn-outline{background:transparent; color:var(--text); border:1px solid var(--border);}
  .btn-outline:hover{border-color:var(--text-dim);}
  .btn-whatsapp{background:transparent; color:#5FD97A; border:1px solid #234A2C;}
  .btn-whatsapp:hover{border-color:#5FD97A; background:#0F1F13;}
  .btn-call{background:transparent; color:#7CB8FF; border:1px solid #1E3A5C;}
  .btn-call:hover{border-color:#7CB8FF; background:#0E1C2C;}

  /* ---------- Metrics panel ---------- */
  .metrics-panel{
    background:var(--bg-panel);
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:12px;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .metrics-head{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
    padding:12px 18px;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft);
  }
  .metrics-head .mono{font-size:0.7rem; color:var(--text-dim2); letter-spacing:0.1em;}
  .dots{display:flex; gap:6px;}
  .dots span{width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; display:inline-block;}
  .dots span:nth-child(1){background:#F0637A;}
  .dots span:nth-child(2){background:#EDA33B;}
  .dots span:nth-child(3){background:#4FD1C5;}
  .stat-row{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); }
  .stat{ padding:22px 20px; border-left:1px solid var(--border-soft); }
  .stat:first-child{border-left:none;}
  .stat .num{
    font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif; font-weight:700;
    font-size:clamp(1.4rem,3vw,2rem);
    color:var(--amber);
    display:block;
  }
  .stat .label{ font-size:0.76rem; color:var(--text-dim); margin-top:6px; }

  /* ---------- Sections ---------- */
  section{
    max-width:1080px; margin:0 auto;
    padding:80px 40px 20px;
    scroll-margin-top:80px;
  }
  .section-head{ display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:14px; margin-bottom:8px; }
  .section-num{
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
    font-size:0.78rem; color:var(--text-dim2);
    letter-spacing:0.08em;
  }
  .section-title{ font-size:clamp(1.5rem,3.2vw,2.1rem); margin:0; color:var(--text); }
  .section-tagline{
    color:var(--text-dim); font-size:0.98rem; margin:8px 0 40px;
    max-width:680px; line-height:1.6;
  }
  #ld .section-num{color:var(--amber);}
  #quality .section-num{color:var(--teal);}
  #scrum .section-num{color:var(--coral);}
  #competencies .section-num{color:var(--amber);}

  .exp-bar{
    display:flex; width:100%; height:34px;
    border-radius:8px; overflow:hidden;
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    margin:8px 0 24px;
  }
  .exp-bar span{ display:block; height:100%; }
  .exp-legend{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
    gap:16px;
  }
  .exp-item{
    background:var(--bg-card);
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:10px;
    padding:18px;
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .exp-item::before{ content:""; position:absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:3px; }
  .exp-item:nth-child(1)::before{background:var(--amber);}
  .exp-item:nth-child(2)::before{background:var(--teal);}
  .exp-item:nth-child(3)::before{background:var(--violet);}
  .exp-item:nth-child(4)::before{background:var(--coral);}
  .exp-item .exp-years{
    font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif; font-weight:700;
    font-size:1.5rem; color:var(--text); display:block; margin:4px 0 6px;
  }
  .exp-item .exp-company{
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace; font-size:0.8rem;
    letter-spacing:0.05em; text-transform:uppercase; font-weight:700;
  }
  .exp-item:nth-child(1) .exp-company{color:var(--amber);}
  .exp-item:nth-child(2) .exp-company{color:var(--teal);}
  .exp-item:nth-child(3) .exp-company{color:var(--violet);}
  .exp-item:nth-child(4) .exp-company{color:var(--coral);}
  .exp-item .exp-role{ font-size:0.86rem; color:var(--text-dim); margin-top:4px; }
  @media (max-width:820px){ .exp-legend{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);} }
  @media (max-width:560px){ .exp-legend{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }

  .comp-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:24px; margin-top:10px; }
  .comp-col .comp-title{
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
    font-size:0.74rem; letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase;
    margin-bottom:16px; font-weight:600;
  }
  .comp-col:nth-child(1) .comp-title{color:var(--amber);}
  .comp-col:nth-child(2) .comp-title{color:var(--teal);}
  .comp-col:nth-child(3) .comp-title{color:var(--violet);}
  .comp-col:nth-child(4) .comp-title{color:var(--coral);}
  .comp-list{list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0;}
  .comp-list li{
    font-size:0.86rem; color:var(--text-dim);
    padding:10px 0;
    border-bottom:1px dashed var(--border-soft);
    display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:8px;
  }
  .comp-list li:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .comp-list li::before{content:"›"; font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;}
  .comp-col:nth-child(1) li::before{color:var(--amber);}
  .comp-col:nth-child(2) li::before{color:var(--teal);}
  .comp-col:nth-child(3) li::before{color:var(--violet);}
  .comp-col:nth-child(4) li::before{color:var(--coral);}

  .subhead{
    font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif; font-weight:600;
    font-size:1.05rem; margin:36px 0 14px; color:var(--text);
  }
  p.body-text{
    line-height:1.7; color:var(--text-dim); max-width:720px; margin:0 0 14px;
    font-size:0.96rem;
  }

  /* ---------- Engagement cards ---------- */
  .cards{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));
    gap:16px;
    margin:20px 0 10px;
  }
  .card{
    background:var(--bg-card);
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:10px;
    padding:22px 22px 20px;
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .card::before{ content:""; position:absolute; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:3px; }
  #ld .card::before{background:var(--amber);}
  #quality .card::before{background:var(--teal);}
  #scrum .card::before{background:var(--coral);}
  .card h4{
    font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif; font-size:1rem; margin:6px 0 10px;
    font-weight:600; color:var(--text);
  }
  .card .role{ font-size:0.85rem; color:var(--text-dim); margin-bottom:12px; line-height:1.55; }
  .card .actions{ font-size:0.85rem; color:var(--text-dim); line-height:1.55; margin-bottom:14px; }
  .card .actions b{font-weight:600; color:var(--text);}
  .outcome{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
    font-size:0.74rem;
    background:var(--bg-panel);
    border:1px solid var(--border-soft);
    padding:7px 10px;
    border-radius:6px;
    color:var(--text);
  }

  /* ---------- Project card (distinct) ---------- */
  .project-card{
    background:var(--bg-card);
    border:1px solid var(--amber);
    border-radius:12px;
    padding:26px 26px 22px;
    margin-top:16px;
    position:relative;
  }
  .project-card .proj-eyebrow{
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
    font-size:0.7rem; letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--amber); margin-bottom:8px; display:block;
  }
  .project-card h4{
    font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif; font-size:1.2rem;
    margin:0 0 14px; color:var(--text); font-weight:700;
  }
  .project-list{list-style:none; margin:0 0 20px; padding:0;}
  .project-list li{
    font-size:0.9rem; color:var(--text-dim); line-height:1.6;
    padding:8px 0 8px 20px; position:relative;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft);
  }
  .project-list li:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .project-list li::before{
    content:"→"; position:absolute; left:0; color:var(--amber);
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
  }
  .btn-launch{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
    font-size:0.78rem; font-weight:600;
    padding:11px 18px;
    border-radius:7px;
    background:var(--amber);
    color:#1A1200;
    text-decoration:none;
    transition:filter .2s;
  }
  .btn-launch:hover{filter:brightness(1.08);}
  .embed-frame{
    margin-top:20px;
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:10px;
    overflow:hidden;
    background:#fff;
  }
  .embed-frame-head{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
    padding:10px 14px;
    background:var(--bg-panel);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft);
  }
  .embed-frame-head .mono{font-size:0.7rem; color:var(--text-dim2); letter-spacing:0.08em;}
  .embed-frame iframe{
    width:100%; height:640px; border:none; display:block;
  }

  /* ---------- Capability chips ---------- */
  .chip-list{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; margin:16px 0 8px;}
  .chip{
    font-size:0.82rem;
    padding:9px 14px;
    background:var(--bg-card);
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:8px;
    color:var(--text-dim);
    max-width:100%;
  }

  /* ---------- Divider ---------- */
  .divider{ max-width:1080px; margin:50px auto 0; padding:0 40px; }
  .divider hr{border:none; border-top:1px solid var(--border-soft); margin:0;}

  /* ---------- Closing ---------- */
  footer{ max-width:1080px; margin:0 auto; padding:80px 40px 100px; }
  .edu-list{list-style:none; padding:0; margin:20px 0 0; max-width:640px;}
  .edu-list li{
    padding:14px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft);
    font-size:0.94rem; display:flex; gap:14px; color:var(--text-dim);
  }
  .edu-list li:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
  .edu-list .dot{
    width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--amber);
    margin-top:8px; flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .footnote{ margin-top:30px; font-size:0.84rem; color:var(--text-dim2); font-style:italic; }
  .site-footer-bottom{
    max-width:1080px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 40px 60px;
    font-size:0.76rem; color:var(--text-dim2);
    font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;
  }

  @media (max-width:980px){
    .comp-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
  }
  @media (max-width:820px){
    .stat-row{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); row-gap:0;}
    .stat:nth-child(3){border-left:none;}
  }
  @media (max-width:560px){
    .comp-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  }
  @media (max-width:720px){
    .nav-links{display:none;}
    nav{padding:14px 20px;}
    header.hero{padding:40px 20px 40px;}
    section{padding:60px 20px 10px;}
    footer{padding:60px 20px 80px;}
  }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
    html{scroll-behavior:auto;}
    *{transition:none !important;}
  }
</style>
</head>

  <div class="nav-name">• <span>Latheesh.Nair</span> / L&amp;D–QUALITY–PM</div>

<header class="hero">
  <h1 class="hero-title">LATHEESH <span class="accent">NAIR</span></h1>
  <p class="eyebrow" style="margin:0 0 26px;">— Senior Manager — Learning &amp; Development, Training, Talent Development &amp; Quality Leadership</p>
  <p class="hero-role">I build training, quality, and process-improvement functions from the ground up — SOPs, LMS platforms, Train-the-Trainer programs — and partner with Operations, Sales, and Leadership to turn them into repeatable systems large teams run on. <b>25+ years</b> across Healthcare IT, Clinical Documentation, Logistics Technology, BPO, and Enterprise Operations, now targeting a <b>Senior Manager – Training, L&amp;D and Quality leader</b> role driving enterprise-wide learning strategy for large, distributed teams.</p>

  <div class="btn-row">

    <a class="btn btn-outline" href="http://www.linkedin.com/in/latheesh-nair" target="_blank" rel="noopener">LinkedIn ↗</a>
    <a class="btn btn-call" href="tel:+919320907077">
      📞 +91 93209 07077 · Call
    </a>
    <a class="btn btn-whatsapp" href="https://wa.me/919320907077" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
      💬 +91 93209 07077 · WhatsApp
    </a>
  </div>

  <div class="metrics-panel">
    <div class="metrics-head">
      <span class="mono">LIVE_METRICS.LOG</span>
      <div class="dots"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat-row">
      <div class="stat"><span class="num">25+</span><span class="label">Years across L&amp;D, Quality &amp; Ops</span></div>
      <div class="stat"><span class="num">98%</span><span class="label">Peak training throughput</span></div>
      <div class="stat"><span class="num">2,500+</span><span class="label">Trainee gradings delivered</span></div>
      <div class="stat"><span class="num">3</span><span class="label">Disciplines, one operating pattern</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<section id="experience">
  <div class="section-head">
    <span class="section-num" style="color:var(--amber);">ZONE_01</span>
    <h2 class="section-title">25+ Years, Four Chapters</h2>
  </div>
  <p class="section-tagline">How the 25+ years break down by company, role, and tenure — from entry-level transcription to enterprise training &amp; quality leadership.</p>

  <div class="exp-bar">

    <span style="width:64%; background:var(--teal);" title="IKS Health Limited — 17 years"></span>

    <span style="width:6%; background:var(--coral);" title="Avinash Information Technology — 1.5 years"></span>

  <div class="exp-legend">

      <span class="exp-years">1 yr</span>
      <div class="exp-role">Training Manager</div>

    <div class="exp-item">

      <span class="exp-years">17 yrs</span>
      <div class="exp-role">Team Manager</div>
    </div>
    <div class="exp-item">
      <span class="exp-company">WebSmart</span>

</section>

<section id="competencies">
  <div class="section-head">
    <span class="section-num">ZONE_02</span>
    <h2 class="section-title">Core Competencies</h2>
  </div>
  <p class="section-tagline">One operating pattern across three disciplines: build the structure, train the people, measure the quality, manage the change.</p>

  <div class="comp-grid">
    <div class="comp-col">
      <div class="comp-title">Training &amp; Associate Development</div>
      <ul class="comp-list">
        <li>End-to-end training program design &amp; delivery</li>

      <ul class="comp-list">
        <li>Team leadership &amp; people management</li>
        <li>Change management</li>
        <li>Stakeholder &amp; client relationship management</li>
        <li>Crisis management &amp; communications</li>
        <li>Workforce planning &amp; attrition management</li>
        <li>Budgeting &amp; cost control</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="comp-col">
      <div class="comp-title">Tools &amp; Domain Knowledge</div>
      <ul class="comp-list">
